channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Three minors killed in Colombia armed group crackdown
item.description: Rights groups warn that armed groups are increasingly recruiting children to their ranks through social media.

item.title: Ukrainians mourn community leader killed in Russian strike on Myla
item.description: Ukrainians gathered to mourn Taras Didych, who was killed while rushing to help after a Russian strike.

item.title: Man arrested after Swiss rave shooting that killed woman
item.description: A 22-year-old Italian woman was killed and several injured at a techno rave in Aarau.

item.title: 'She slipped out of my hand' - children missing after ferry sinks off northern Cyprus
item.description: Ayten and Hayri Bicer's two young children are among 20 missing in an incident that killed eight people.

item.title: US and Iran trade strikes for first time in weeks
item.description: The attack on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz - the first known US strike since late July - has killed two people and injured two others.

item.title: Deadly strike on Kyiv warehouse prompts evacuations
item.description: Ukraine correspondent Dan Johnson reports from Kyiv after the deadly strike, which authorities said killed more than 30 people.

item.title: BBC tracks one week of Israeli settler violence in occupied West Bank
item.description: The BBC's Lucy Williamson reports on settler attacks on Palestinians, which have been observed over the last week alone.
